---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature, or ask whether something is already possible
labels: enhancement
---

<!--
"Can it already do X?" is a perfectly good use of this form. If the answer is
yes, you get an answer and we've found a documentation gap. Nothing below is
mandatory.
-->

**Package(s)**

Which package this belongs to, or "not sure" — placing it is our job, not yours.

**What you're trying to do**

The problem or workflow, not just the feature. The context of how you run your
tracker is the part only you have, and it often changes what the right answer is.

**Description**

What you'd like to see added or changed.

**Possible Approach**

If you have thoughts on how it could work, include them. Optional.

<!--
Three things this can turn into, all of them useful:

  1. Already possible        — you get an answer, we get a docs gap
  2. Needs a seam exposing   — shapes where the next extension point goes
  3. Belongs in your own
     package                 — you get pointed at the extension point
-->
